question: Which ocean once split Gondwana from Laurasia, 200 million years ago?
answer: About 200 million years ago, an arm of ocean called the Tethys wedged between the blocks of Gondwana and Laurasia. When those two blocks collided, the Tethys closed.
move: Gondwana and Laurasia were split by the Tethys, an ocean arm that closed when they collided.
